name: github-issues
description: Open GitHub issues that match the captain's watch rule in each project's repository, and which of them Firstmate already has in hand.

labels.title: Labels to watch
labels.description: An open issue with any of these labels is watched; each label at most 50 characters. Leave it empty to watch none by label.

assignee.title: Assigned to
assignee.description: A GitHub login written without @ (octocat), or @me for you; an open issue assigned to them is watched. Leave it empty to watch none by assignee.

mode.title: When a new issue turns up
mode.description: Ringing the bell or handing it to Firstmate happens once per issue.
